declared_by: owner requirement 2026-10-25 (one canonical production promotion gate)
declaration_note: Every value below was fixed BEFORE any candidate was scored under this gate. Most of them are values this estate had already declared before 2026-10-25 (see 'provenance'), reused rather than re-chosen so they cannot have been tuned on the candidates they now judge. Changing any value is a new gate_version and an architecture change that needs owner approval. Justification for each value is in src/promotion_gate.py.

tracks.rule: config.model_type_for_league(league) -> standard | new_format | unknown. Every criterion is computed per track; tracks are never pooled. A track below min_n_per_track is reported and excluded; at least one track must be evaluable and every evaluable track must pass.

provenance.min_n_per_track_holdout: MIN_N = 1000 in src/champion_gate.py (2026-10-18) and src/promotion_gate.py (2026-10-01); GATE.min_rows_holdout = 1000 in Pro src/models/registry.py
provenance.sd_ratio / max_frac_moved: spread x1.5 and >25% moved >10pp, pipeline._behaviour_canary, set from the 2026-09-23 incident
provenance.prospective min_n_per_track: n_min_per_track = 1000, models/registry/experiments.json, owner decision 2026-10-25 for H-MODEL-01
provenance.bootstrap_unit: match-date blocks, as src/shadow_experiments.evaluate and Pro src/analytics/model_lineage._day_boot_ci already use
provenance.new in PG-1.0: max_mean_shift, max_quantile_shift, extreme share, slope check, early_fail_min_n, max_age_days, min_bootstrap_blocks
